title: Snail eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='84' rx='38' ry='6' fill='#2a3d5c'/>
  <!-- snail body (foot) -->
  <path d='M12 78 Q10 68 20 66 L72 66 Q86 66 88 74 Q90 82 78 82 L18 82 Q12 82 12 78 Z' fill='#7fd6a8' stroke='#a9f0c8' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- foot bottom highlight -->
  <path d='M18 80 L78 80' stroke='#c7ffe0' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- shell -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='48' r='26' fill='#ff9f4a' stroke='#ffd08a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <path d='M40 48 m0 -18 a18 18 0 1 1 -1 0' fill='none' stroke='#ffe0a8' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M40 48 m0 -11 a11 11 0 1 0 1 0' fill='none' stroke='#ffe0a8' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M40 48 m0 -4 a4 4 0 1 1 -1 0' fill='#ffb45c'/>
  <!-- shell swirl highlights -->
  <path d='M24 34 Q34 26 46 32' fill='none' stroke='#ffcf8f' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- neck/head -->
  <path d='M78 66 Q86 60 88 52 Q90 46 84 46 Q80 52 74 58 Z' fill='#7fd6a8' stroke='#a9f0c8' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='84' cy='48' rx='10' ry='9' fill='#7fd6a8' stroke='#a9f0c8' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- eye stalks -->
  <path d='M80 42 Q78 32 82 28' fill='none' stroke='#a9f0c8' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M88 42 Q90 32 86 28' fill='none' stroke='#a9f0c8' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='82' cy='27' r='4' fill='#e8fff4' stroke='#7fd6a8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='27' r='4' fill='#e8fff4' stroke='#7fd6a8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='82.5' cy='27.5' r='2' fill='#34405e'/>
  <circle cx='86.5' cy='27.5' r='2' fill='#34405e'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M80 50 Q84 54 88 50' fill='none' stroke='#3f8f68' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- snack: little strawberry -->
  <path d='M92 62 Q98 60 98 68 Q98 76 92 78 Q86 76 86 68 Q86 60 92 62 Z' fill='#ff5a5a' stroke='#ff9a9a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- strawberry seeds -->
  <circle cx='90' cy='67' r='1' fill='#ffe0e0'/>
  <circle cx='94' cy='68' r='1' fill='#ffe0e0'/>
  <circle cx='92' cy='72' r='1' fill='#ffe0e0'/>
  <circle cx='89' cy='73' r='1' fill='#ffe0e0'/>
  <circle cx='95' cy='74' r='1' fill='#ffe0e0'/>
  <!-- leaves -->
  <path d='M92 62 L88 56 L92 58 L94 55 L94 61 Z' fill='#5ad66a' stroke='#a9f0a0' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- bite mark -->
  <circle cx='87' cy='68' r='2.5' fill='#7fd6a8'/>
  <!-- little crumbs -->
  <circle cx='82' cy='73' r='1.2' fill='#ff8a8a'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='68' r='1' fill='#ff8a8a'/>
</svg>
